text: Sorry to hear about this! So the immigration office in Israel is wrong - you can definitely invite her as a tourist, and this will prevent her being delayed when trying to enter Israel. You can read more about this on our website - see the part about "The tourist invitation process", which also links to the page and the form. We recommend submitting the application a few months in advance if possible, as sometimes they are slow :)  https://aic.org.il/entry-to-israel-of-a-foreign-partner-of-an-israeli/
